# Synthetic fixtures — NOT real Xiaohongshu data

These files were hand-written to match the JSON shapes defined in the projects'
source code (xpzouying/xiaohongshu-mcp `xiaohongshu/types.go`, `service.go`,
`types.go`; JoeanAmier/XHS-Downloader `source/application/explore.py`, `app.py`).
All IDs, names, counts and URLs are fake (`FIXTURE…`, `example.invalid`).
They exist only to test `tools/xhs_export.py`. No platform data was collected.
